requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: API key for the AI judge that reads each quote and donor priority pair (and confirms the embedding shortlist).

requirements.name: DATA_DIR
requirements.description: The directory on the application's own disk where the site keeps its JSON records (candidates, pairings, priorities, reviews, the fetch log) and the static pages it generates. Peradapt attaches a persistent disk at /data in production, so everything under it survives restarts and deploys.

datastore.capacity_basis: A few hundred small JSON records, a handful of cached caption transcripts (about 200 KB each, a few new ones a week), one money snapshot of about 1 MB and the generated pages come to well under 1 GB in a year.

requirements.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
requirements.description: The secret the site's maintainer enters to sign in to the review queue and priority form.

requirements.name: FETCH_CONTACT_EMAIL
requirements.description: The contact email put in the user agent of the site's fetching, so the sources can reach the maintainer.

requirements.name: DATASF_APP_TOKEN
requirements.description: A DataSF app token for the campaign finance queries. The site reads the public datasets without it; the token only lifts the rate limit.
